evidence: The thickness of the ZrO 2 ﬁlms was measured by ellipsometer (SOPRA, GES5E) with refractive indexes (PET: 1.57 and ZrO 2:2 . 1 5 ) and conﬁrmed by transmission electron microscopy (TEM, JEOL-2100F). X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS, VG ESCALAB MK II) was applied to study the compositions in the ZrO 2 ﬁlms, which was con ﬁrmed by energy dispersive X-ray analysis (EDX, JEOL JEM-3010). The surface morphology was investigated by atomic force microscopy (AFM, XE-100). X-ray diffraction (XRD, Rigaku RU-200BH) and TEM were carried out to determine the crystallinity of the ZrO 2 ﬁlms. The leakage current was measured using a Keithley 2400 semiconductor parameter analyzer and the capacitance was measured using a HP 4283 LCR meter at frequencies varying from 100 Hz to 1 MHz.
